meta.title: W4 SSI-surgery widget data (classic SSI on BLS nonfarm payrolls)
meta.index_convention: j is the 1-based Fourier grid index of the length-n_e whitened aligned grid; omega_j = 2*pi*j/n_e (compute from j and n_e in JS for exact phases). shared.omega/pgram_before are indexed by j (array position j). t is the 1-based index into dlog_nsa/final_dlog_check (dlog_nsa[t] = log_nsa[t+1] - log_nsa[t]).
meta.coef_convention: delta_j(t) = Re( (c_re + i*c_im) * exp(i * omega_j * (t - t0)) ) for t >= t0, and 0 for t < t0. partial_dlog(t, k) = dlog_nsa(t) + sum_{j <= k} delta_j(t) over the first k targets in animation order. Exact up to an AR-recoloring transient (< 5e-3, decaying x0.175/step from t0); ALWAYS snap the finished state to final_dlog_check. Levels: loglvl[1] = log_nsa[1]; loglvl[t+1] = loglvl[t] + partial_dlog(t); level = exp(loglvl). The first t0 level entries never change.

benchmark.rule: Proportional (multiplicative) per-year matching on positional 12-observation blocks from index 1 (== calendar years here): factor_y = year_sums_nsa[y] / sum(level[(y-1)*12+1 .. y*12]); benchmarked[t] = level[t] * factor_y within year y's block. JS mirrors this at every animation frame on the CURRENT reconstruction (deterministic accounting arithmetic -- the spec s1.5 exception to 'no statistics in JS'); the finished state must reproduce final_level_bench within 1e-6 relative.
benchmark.js_needs: Nothing beyond year sums: use shared.benchmark.year_sums_nsa (or recompute from shared.level_nsa -- identical by construction).

meta.schema_note: v2 (2026-08-14): adds yearly-total benchmarking -- meta.benchmark, shared.benchmark, and per-variant final_level_bench[n_obs] + evt_after_bench {statistic, p} (band variant included). v1 fields unchanged.
meta.standardization: pgram_before is the RAW periodogram of the whitened residuals (|DFT|^2/n_e), the domain of donor thresholds/levels/pgram_after. The detection test sees it divided by var(e - mean(e)) -- a constant factor, i.e. a constant offset on the log10 axis.

defaults.note: Variant grid runs classic SSI (target_set='bins', which REQUIRES phase_rule='zero'); everything else at package defaults. The detected-spec default path is the band branch -- see the is_band_default variant.

variants.note: Package-default run (target_set='auto', phase_rule='minimum'): detected spec is 'band', so the surgery divides the whole spectrum by the estimated gain and de-rotates by the minimum phase. It imputes nothing (draw method 'none'), is fully deterministic (seeds inert), and carries no per-ordinate coefficients. Exported for comparison only.
